text: S675 route review is complete. None of the already tested local routes meets the fixed receiver/unit entry gate: LibreCAD R12 omits the source centimeter declaration; CLO is unitless or has measured semantic/readability failures; DGS lacks usable DXF pattern exchange; Open CAD Studio R14 is generic and unitless. Existing 73-option and 35-size evidence remains reusable only after a qualified receiver exists. Preserve all acceptance; no new app/format trial is queued. The exact remaining dependency and optional scope-amendment boundary are in E-G04-S675-EXIT.
